subject: ela
intro: Compare and contrast two texts on the same topic.

items.prompt:
Text A and Text B both say sharks are fish. They:
A) agree on that
B) disagree
C) are about different topics

Text A tells what sharks eat; Text B tells where sharks live. They:
A) cover different parts of the topic
B) are exactly the same
C) are about the moon
items.answer: A) cover different parts of the topic

solution.answer: A) cover different parts of the topic

items.prompt:
Reading two texts on one topic usually gives you:
A) more facts
B) fewer facts
C) no facts

Both texts about the moon say it orbits Earth. This is a point they:
A) agree on
B) disagree on
C) never mention

Text A uses a diagram; Text B uses only words. This is a difference in their:
A) topic
B) text features
C) authors' ages

Text A: facts about rain. Text B: facts about snow. Their shared big topic is:
A) weather
B) sports
C) food

steps: Both about weather. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Text A says a bat is a mammal; Text B says a bat can fly and uses sound to find food. Reading BOTH, you learn:
A) only that bats fly
B) that a bat is a flying mammal that uses sound
C) nothing new
items.answer: B) that a bat is a flying mammal that uses sound

steps: Combine facts from both. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) that a bat is a flying mammal that uses sound

items.prompt:
Two texts about volcanoes: one explains WHY they erupt, the other shows a map of WHERE they are. Together they:
A) repeat the same idea
B) give a fuller picture (why and where)
C) are about different topics
items.answer: B) give a fuller picture (why and where)

steps: Different parts combine. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) give a fuller picture (why and where)
